intro: Ruth is a short story of loyalty, love and quiet faith, set in the days of the judges.
In chapter one, a widow named Naomi returns home with her foreign daughter-in-law, Ruth, who refuses to leave her. In chapters two to four, Ruth meets Boaz, a kind relative who rescues the family.
Its author isn't named; tradition credits Samuel.
Listen for kindness, and for the very last lines: Ruth becomes the great-grandmother of King David.

card.parts: Ch. 1: loss, and loyalty | Ch. 2–4: Ruth and Boaz
